sentences.en: The ship was drifting at the mercy of the waves.
sentences.zh: 那艘船在波浪中随波逐流。

sentences.en: Light waves travel through space and various kinds of materials.
sentences.zh: 光线以波动的形式在空间和各种材料中传播。

sentences.en: Do you know the girl waving at us over there?
sentences.zh: 你看到那边挥手的女孩了吗？
